vision.note: OCR transcription. First 3 concurrent passes build consensus; after that the page is locked for vision unless disputed.

visual.note: Media/context capture (screenshot + verbatim documentary context). Single-slot — one volunteer at a time.

review.note: Human hand-typing disputed pages. Single-slot; human always wins canonical.

revalidation.note: Re-OCR of disputed pages by volunteers (volunteer.mjs --review). Two concurrent allowed for cross-check.
